scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && npm run fix-imports && npm run copy-assets
scripts.copy-assets: mkdir -p dist/vendor && cp index.html dist/index.html && cp node_modules/hash-wasm/dist/index.esm.min.js dist/vendor/hash-wasm.esm.min.js && ([ -f node_modules/hash-wasm/LICENSE ] && cp node_modules/hash-wasm/LICENSE dist/vendor/hash-wasm.LICENSE || true) && ([ -f common_passwords.txt ] && cp common_passwords.txt dist/ || true) && ([ -f style.css ] && cp style.css dist/ || true)
